specs.title: semantic diagnostics locate the source, preserve the home, and clear on repair
a new site is readable at once: the home page and its two pages
a save reloads the page it changed in place and leaves the others
a real symlink target save refreshes its image and survives deletion and recovery
a snapshot attachment in content/manual.pdf recovers when only its target is restored
a snapshot attachment in static/manual.pdf recovers when only its target is restored
arbitrary CSS resources keep numeric entity delimiters and compiler URL decoding
template contents are rejected as anchors while their holder and ordinary IDs navigate
body anchors at / navigate on the same and other pages and recover from ghost links
body anchors at /docs/ navigate on the same and other pages and recover from ghost links
self-closing SVG template preserves document anchors and cross-page navigation
paired SVG template preserves document anchors and cross-page navigation
SVG inside an HTML template preserves document anchors and cross-page navigation
HTML templates at foreign integration points recover from ghost links
a failed build keeps the page readable under a panel that hides to a marker and clears on the fix
while nothing has built, every page says so, and becomes the site once it builds
a restarted dev brings an open page up to date
a panic in a build is one more problem, and the next build is served
the panel speaks the page's language
on a phone the panel is a sheet along the bottom and nothing scrolls sideways
axe finds no serious or critical problem with the panel open or hidden, in both modes
